title: The Guilt Offering

questions.question: What happened if someone heard a public oath and did not speak up as a witness?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:1 (ESV): "If anyone sins in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, and though he is a witness... if he does not speak, he shall bear his iniquity."

questions.question: What must a person do when they realize they have sinned?
options: Confess the sin he has committed
questions.correctAnswer: Confess the sin he has committed
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:5 (ESV): "When he realizes his guilt... he shall confess the sin he has committed."

questions.question: What was the standard guilt offering?
options: A female from the flock, a lamb or a goat
questions.correctAnswer: A female from the flock, a lamb or a goat
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:6 (ESV): "He shall bring to the Lord as his compensation... a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering."

questions.question: What could a poor person bring if they could not afford a lamb?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:7 (ESV): "If he cannot afford a lamb, then he shall bring... two turtledoves or two pigeons."

questions.question: What was required for sinning against the holy things of the Lord?
options: A ram without blemish and restitution plus a fifth
questions.correctAnswer: A ram without blemish and restitution plus a fifth
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:15-16 (ESV): "He shall bring to the Lord as his compensation a ram without blemish... and shall add a fifth to it."

questions.question: What was the offering for one too poor even for birds?
options: A tenth of an ephah of fine flour
questions.correctAnswer: A tenth of an ephah of fine flour
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:11 (ESV): "If he cannot afford two turtledoves or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering... a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering."

questions.question: What was forbidden to add to the flour sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:11 (ESV): "He shall put no oil on it and shall put no frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering."

questions.question: Of the two birds brought by the poor, what was done with the first?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:8-9 (ESV): "He shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer first the one for the sin offering."

questions.question: What was done with the second bird?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:10 (ESV): "Then he shall offer the second for a burnt offering."

questions.question: What situations could cause a person to sin described in this chapter?
options: Touching unclean things, rash oaths, or withholding testimony
questions.correctAnswer: Touching unclean things, rash oaths, or withholding testimony
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:1-4 (ESV) lists withholding testimony, touching unclean things, and making rash oaths.

questions.question: How was the bird for the sin offering killed?
options: Its head wrung off but not completely severed
questions.correctAnswer: Its head wrung off but not completely severed
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:8 (ESV): "He shall wring its head from its neck but shall not sever it completely."

questions.question: What was the value standard for the guilt offering ram?
options: Valued in shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary
questions.correctAnswer: Valued in shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:15 (ESV): "A ram without blemish out of the flock, valued in silver shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary."

questions.question: What happened to the remaining flour offering after the memorial portion?
options: It belonged to the priest, as in a grain offering
questions.correctAnswer: It belonged to the priest, as in a grain offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:13 (ESV): "The rest shall be for the priest, as in the grain offering."

questions.question: If someone sinned but did not know which commandment they broke, what happened?
options: They were still guilty and needed to bring a ram
questions.correctAnswer: They were still guilty and needed to bring a ram
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:17-18 (ESV): "If anyone sins, doing any of the things that by the Lord's commandments ought not to be done, though he did not know it, then realizes his guilt, he shall bear his iniquity. He shall bring to the priest a ram without blemish."

questions.question: What was the additional penalty beyond the offering for sin against holy things?
options: Add a fifth of its value to the restitution
questions.correctAnswer: Add a fifth of its value to the restitution
questions.explanation: Leviticus 5:16 (ESV): "He shall also make restitution for what he has done amiss in the holy thing and shall add a fifth to it."

key_verse_text: When he realizes his guilt in any of these and confesses the sin he has committed, he shall bring to the Lord as his compensation... a female from the flock.
